items.title: Introducing SFX v3 in ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' SFX v3 brings more reliable multi-sound prompts, cleaner audio and more convincing music and vocals, opening up effects that pair a musical phrase or vocal performance with everyday sounds.
items.rationale: New model release from the primary source. Sound designers and producers can use the multi-sound prompts and better music and vocal generation now, in the app and through the API.

items.title: Spotify Reportedly Set to Debut AI Cover & Remix Tool in Early '27
items.excerpt: Spotify is reportedly preparing to launch its long-awaited AI cover and remix tool in early 2027, charging subscribers up to $5 a month extra.
items.rationale: First reported launch window (early 2027) and price ($4-5 a month add-on) for Spotify's fan remix tool. That tells artists when fan-made versions of their tracks will start to appear and what fans will pay.

items.title: UMG talks AI music: 'The volume is growing faster than the safeguards'
items.excerpt: On UMG's Q3 earnings call Lucian Grainge sounded the alarm on AI music, citing Deezer figures of more than 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks uploaded to streaming services every day.
items.rationale: New statement from the largest major label, with a hard figure (more than 90,000 AI tracks uploaded a day). It signals where label policy on AI uploads is heading.

items.title: MiDiff: MIDI-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Drum Audio Enhancement
items.excerpt: MiDiff is a diffusion-based generative model that restores severely degraded drum recordings by conditioning the reverse process on temporally aligned MIDI piano rolls.
items.rationale: New research with a clear studio use: it restores badly degraded drum takes by using a MIDI performance to guide the repair.

items.title: Zeds Dead on two decades of sampling: “The interest is in the history; AI has no history”
items.excerpt: Zeds Dead discuss two decades of sampling-based production and why they see AI-generated material as lacking the history that makes sampling meaningful.
items.rationale: A new interview where working producers explain where they draw the line between sampling and AI-generated material.

https://www.digitalmusicnews.com/2026/10.new_action: New report of a launch target (early 2027) and pricing (a paid add-on of up to $5 a month). Neither was known when the 10-21 opt-in card or the 10-26 co-CEO card ran.
